scope_ambiguity: Scope ambiguity is triggered but no scope contract or explicit shrinkage decision is configured. This story_review row is advisory only; ProofStory gates consume CLI-written artifacts, not prompt text.
High-risk stories must have plan.md (execution plan). Write it following the plan.md template in CLAUDE.md, one section per CHK-xxx

missing_scope_check: scope-check.json is missing PLAN gate evidence. Start a story-level PLAN scope reviewer with `proof-or-stop dispatch --storyId=B-9a49 --agentType=lattice-review-scope-plan`; dispatch output is not gate evidence, and the lattice-review-scope-plan / scope-plan reviewer must finish by calling `proof-or-stop scope_check_save`. The implementation/main agent must not self-sign this evidence or manually edit story metadata. Local CLI guidance is not remote completion and must not be presented as receipt verification or production/full completion.
